ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch.  8 -1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The
 Cases received pursuant to Ind.  Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
P
ursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
An
y approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from  the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.

cd /tmp/r2run-617bzak2/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/a.py <<'E'
import re,glob,collections
rows=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('ord_*.txt')):
    m=re.search(r'(\d\d)\.?(\d\d)\.?(\d\d)\.txt',f); yr=2000+int(m.group(3))
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    for p in re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)[1:]:
        if not re.search(r'Abstentions',p,re.I) : continue
        i=re.search(r'Abstentions\s*:?',p,re.I)
        rest=p[i.end():]
        j=re.search(r'Additional\s+Inf|APPROVED',rest)
        fld=rest[:j.start()] if j else rest
        raw=fld
        fld=re.sub(r'Additional Inf[o\w]*mation:?','',fld).strip()
        rows.append((f,yr,raw.strip(),fld))
print(len(rows))
c=collections.Counter(r[3] for r in rows);print(c)
by=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
for f,y,r,fl in rows:
    by[y][0]+=1; by[y][1]+=bool(fl)
for y in sorted(by): print(y,by[y],round(100*by[y][1]/by[y][0],1))
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/a.py

cd /tmp/r2run-617bzak2/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/b.py <<'E'
import re,glob
n=a=0;nf=0
for f in sorted(glob.glob('ord_*.txt')):
    t=open(f,errors='replace').read()
    for p in re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)[1:]:
        h=bool(re.search(r'Case\s*Number',p)); b=bool(re.search('Abstentions',p,re.I))
        n+=h;a+=b
        if h!=b: print(f,h,b)
print(n,a)
E

content.text:
Share of cases with a recorded abstention, by order year (order year taken from the date in each filename):

| Order year | Cases | With a recorded abstention | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 1,603 | 662 | **41.3%** |
| 2024 | 1,897 | 1,025 | **54.0%** |
| 2025 | 1,684 | 838 | **49.8%** |

I counted a case as having an abstention if its Abstentions field had any text left after trimming spaces and deleting the stray "Additional Information:" and "Additional Infonnation:" words.

The values found were mostly committee-member names: Smith (3,825 cases), Warren (1,033) and a handful of others.

One page, in the 2022 nunc pro tunc order, didn't match my "Abstentions" search, so it was left out of the counts. It doesn't affect these three years.
